# Design point P016

## Description

The system places repository replicas across separate racks, so copies remain available through individual-node or rack-level failures. Its write policy accepts changes only with a permanent data-loss guarantee, ensuring accepted pushes, merges, edits, and repository creations are not corrupted or reverted.
